symptoms.label: Symptoms to treat
symptoms.title: Do you notice hardness, inflammation, or discomfort after your surgery?
symptoms.desc: It's completely normal for hematomas, edema, or fibrosis to appear after an intervention. Our goal is to treat them in time to ensure that the final result is what you always dreamed of.

items.title: Surgical Fibrosis
items.desc: We treat accumulations of scar tissue that generate hardness and irregularities under the skin.

items.title: Edema and Inflammation
items.desc: We accelerate the elimination of accumulated fluids to reduce volume and pressure.

items.title: Hematomas
items.desc: We improve local circulation so that bruises disappear more quickly.

vital.label: Why is it vital?
vital.title: Post-operative care is 50% of your surgery's success
items: Significant reduction in pain and tension
Faster return to your daily activities

steps.title: Assessment
steps.desc: We analyze your type of surgery and the current state of the tissues.

steps.title: Drainage
steps.desc: We activate the lymphatic system to evacuate liquids and toxins.

steps.title: Defibrosis
steps.desc: We manually work on the hard areas to soften them.

steps.title: Follow-up
steps.desc: We monitor your progress until the tissue is 100% healthy.

items.q: When should I start my massages?
items.a: Generally from 48-72 hours for gentle lymphatic drainage. For fibrosis work, we usually start from the 3rd week.
Lymphatic drainage is a very gentle and painless technique. Defibrosis work can generate some discomfort, but it is always adapted to your sensitivity.

items.q: How many sessions will I need?
items.a: It depends on the surgery and how your body responds. The average for a liposuction or abdominoplasty is 10 to 15 sessions.
